But now we’re entering a point where the output of working with AI can and should dramatically exceed what you would been able to do before, in a fraction of the time.

The product prototype should not only be fully functional and interactive, but it should probably have meaningfully better features than it would have had before. The engineering architecture should be able to deliver performance gains that you wouldn’t have been able to go after otherwise.

Um, and, uh, Arca's, uh, recently raised sixty-four million for an AI-native wealth management firm. Uh, so first of all, Aman, can you tell us a bit about your role at Arca and, um, the financial services you provide and, um, how you're using AI agents to run them? Yeah, for sure. Um, thanks for having me. Um, my role at Arca is I lead the AI platform team, so we're building the underlying sort of, um, harness and our capabilities to kind of run the business with AI, which is our ultimate goal. Um, in terms of the services that we provide to our clients, um, we-- This is a broad spectrum of financial services. So that includes, um, sort of financial advice, financial planning for, um, for their assets, um, and sort of, um, uh, tax planning and insurance and estate planning as, as people get wealthier. Um, maybe you are, um, someone who just sold a business, for example. Mm-hmm. Um, and there's lots of complexities with all the different partners, et cetera, right? So, uh, we can help you think through that. Um, we also have clients that are, you know, uh, really large technology executives that, uh- Mm... have, uh, are trying to figure out a real plan for retiring, retiring early, right? Mm-hmm. Um, and also sm-small families that, um, uh, that are trying to buy their first home, for example. Yeah. Um, yeah. So the, um, the clients that you have so far, are they, um, do you have to kind of talk them through using agents and, and why you're using agents and tell them a little bit about the technology behind it? Yeah. So, um, the role of AI at Arca is not to replace the advisor. It is to replace all of the work around the advisor. Mm. So our clients don't really interface with AI directly. Mm. All they experience is a level of service that has not been, been, um, been possible in this industry before- Mm... delivered through the empathy and care of a human advisor. Um, so we're building the machinery behind, um, every client- Mm... that's constantly thinking about, um, you know, um, what's, what is the market doing, and how does it impact Richard? Mm. You know, um, what are, what, what else is going on in your life? Like, what are you-- what are the s-the, the textures of your life that impact your finances? Um, and, uh, we're able to be way, way more proactive, way more responsive, um, and just deliver a better, um, kind of, uh, level of client service using AI that does all of the, the back office stuff. Okay. So let's get into the, some of the technical aspects of it. Wh-which models are you using to power your agents and, um, how do you decide which model is best for, for which action? Yea...
